title.en: Congestion control: TCP Tahoe after a timeout (R2 · 3)
title.zh: 拥塞控制：TCP Tahoe 超时之后（复2 · 3）

description.en: Why TCP limits its own speed, how slow start and additive increase grow the window, what Tahoe does on a timeout, the four round trips worked line by line, and how Reno differs.
description.zh: TCP 为什么要自己限速，慢启动和加法增大怎样让窗口变大，Tahoe 遇到超时怎么做，逐行算出那四个往返，以及 Reno 有什么不同。

name.en: The idea of congestion control and TCP's signal: loss as a signal, AIMD
name.zh: 拥塞控制的思路与 TCP 的信号 (congestion control principle, loss as signal, AIMD)
TCP Tahoe 与 TCP Reno (TCP Tahoe and TCP Reno)

description.en: Computing the new threshold from the old threshold instead of the window at the loss
description.zh: 用旧阈值而不是丢包时的窗口来算新阈值

description.en: Doubling the window past the slow start threshold
description.zh: 过了慢启动阈值还在翻倍

paras.en: Assume TCP Tahoe is being used and the slow start threshold is currently set to 10KB. A segment timeout occurs when the congestion window is 16KB. What will the slow start threshold be after this timeout? After the timeout, the congestion window is reset to 1. What is the congestion window for the following 4 round trips if no further loss occurs?
paras.zh: 假设使用的是 TCP Tahoe，慢启动阈值当前设为 10KB。拥塞窗口为 16KB 时发生了一次报文段超时。超时之后慢启动阈值是多少？超时后拥塞窗口被重置为 1。如果之后不再丢包，接下来 4 个往返的拥塞窗口各是多少？

items.en: **TCP Tahoe** is one version of TCP's congestion control; it is built from the ground up below.
items.zh: **TCP Tahoe** 是 TCP 拥塞控制的一个版本；下面从头把它搭起来。

items.en: **The congestion window** (cwnd, written $W$ here): how much data the sender may have in the network, sent but not yet acknowledged. A bigger window means sending faster.
items.zh: **拥塞窗口**（congestion window，cwnd，这里记作 $W$）：发送方最多可以有多少数据在网络里——已经发出、还没被确认。窗口越大，发得越快。

items.en: **The slow start threshold** (ssthresh, written $S$): the window size at which TCP stops growing fast and starts growing carefully.
items.zh: **慢启动阈值**（slow start threshold，ssthresh，这里记作 $S$）：窗口长到这个大小，TCP 就不再快速增长，改为小心地增长。

items.en: **A segment timeout**: the acknowledgement of a segment did not come back in time. TCP takes it as a sign that the network is congested.
items.zh: **报文段超时**（segment timeout）：某个报文段的确认没有按时回来。TCP 把它当作网络拥塞的信号。

items.en: **Units.** The question gives sizes in KB, then resets the window *to 1*: it counts in segments of 1 KB each. So 16 KB is 16 segments and the threshold of 10 KB is 10 segments.
items.zh: **单位。**题目用 KB 给大小，后面又说窗口重置为 *1*：它是按每段 1 KB 的报文段来数的。所以 16 KB 就是 16 个报文段，阈值 10 KB 就是 10 个。

items.en: **A round trip** (RTT): the time to send a window of data and get its acknowledgements back. TCP adjusts the window once per round trip.
items.zh: **往返**（round trip，RTT）：发出一窗数据、收回它们的确认所用的时间。TCP 每个往返调整一次窗口。

text.en: Two parts: the new threshold, and the window over the next four round trips. The ideas: why TCP limits its own speed at all, how slow start and additive increase grow the window, and what Tahoe does on a timeout.
text.zh: 两问：新的阈值，以及接下来四个往返的窗口。需要的想法：TCP 为什么要自己限速，慢启动和加法增大怎样让窗口长大，以及 Tahoe 遇到超时怎么办。

title.zh: TCP 为什么要自己放慢

text.en: Routers have queues. When more traffic arrives than a link can carry, the queue fills, delays grow, and in the end packets are dropped. Senders whose packets were dropped time out and retransmit, adding yet more traffic: the network can end up busy carrying copies while little useful data, **goodput**, gets through. That is **congestion**.
text.zh: 路由器里有队列。到达的流量超过链路能承载的，队列就会填满，延迟变长，最后开始丢包。包被丢掉的发送方超时重传，又加了更多流量：网络可能忙着运送重复的副本，真正有用的数据（**有效吞吐量** goodput）却没多少能通过。这就是**拥塞**（congestion）。

text.en: Nobody in the network tells a TCP sender how fast to go. So TCP probes: it raises its rate while all goes well, and cuts it back when a segment is lost, reading **loss as the signal** of congestion. The rate is set by the congestion window: about one window of data per round trip.
text.zh: 网络里没有谁会告诉 TCP 发送方该发多快。于是 TCP 自己试探：一切顺利就提速，丢了报文段就降速，**把丢包当作拥塞的信号**。速度由拥塞窗口决定：每个往返大约发一窗的数据。

text.en: Do not confuse it with flow control. Flow control protects the *receiver*: its window is the space left in the receiver's buffer. Congestion control protects the *network* along the whole path. The sender keeps both windows and obeys the smaller.
text.zh: 别和流量控制混在一起。流量控制保护的是*接收方*：它的窗口是接收方缓冲区剩下的空间。拥塞控制保护的是整条路径上的*网络*。发送方两个窗口都记着，按小的那个来发。

title.en: Two ways to grow: slow start and additive increase
title.zh: 两种增长：慢启动和加法增大

text.en: **Slow start.** A connection starts with $W = 1$ segment. Each segment that is acknowledged adds one segment to the window. In the first round trip one segment is acknowledged: $W = 2$. In the next, two are: $W = 4$. Then 8, then 16: **the window doubles every round trip**. It is *slow* only at its start; it grows exponentially, to find the network's capacity quickly.
text.zh: **慢启动**（slow start）。连接开始时 $W = 1$ 个报文段。每确认一个报文段，窗口就加一个报文段。第一个往返确认了 1 个：$W = 2$。下一个往返确认 2 个：$W = 4$。然后 8，然后 16：**窗口每个往返翻一倍**。它只是*起点*慢；增长是指数式的，为的是尽快摸到网络的容量。

text.en: **The threshold.** Doubling cannot go on forever: it would overshoot and cause losses. So when the window reaches the slow start threshold $S$, TCP switches to **additive increase** (also called congestion avoidance): **one more segment per round trip**. Careful, linear growth, close to the level where trouble started last time.
text.zh: **阈值。**不能一直翻倍下去：会冲过头，造成丢包。所以窗口一到慢启动阈值 $S$，TCP 就改成**加法增大**（additive increase，也叫拥塞避免）：**每个往返只加一个报文段**。在上次出问题的水平附近，小心地线性增长。

title.en: What Tahoe does when a segment times out

text.en: On a loss, Tahoe does two things at once:
text.zh: 一旦丢包，Tahoe 同时做两件事：

items.en: **The threshold becomes half the current window**: $S = W/2$. The window at the moment of the loss was too big for the network; half of it is a level that was safe, and the new place to slow down. (This is the *multiplicative decrease* in AIMD, additive increase, multiplicative decrease.)
items.zh: **阈值变为当前窗口的一半**：$S = W/2$。丢包那一刻的窗口对网络来说太大了；它的一半是一个安全的水平，也是下次该放慢的地方。（这就是 AIMD——加法增大、乘法减小——里的*乘法减小*。）

items.en: **The window goes back to 1** and slow start begins again.

text.en: Notice what is **not** used: the old threshold. Once a loss happens, the old threshold has done its job; the new one depends only on the window at the moment of the loss.
text.zh: 注意**没有**用到的东西：旧的阈值。一旦丢包，旧阈值就完成了使命；新阈值只取决于丢包那一刻的窗口。

caption.en: The question's connection, round by round. Drag the moment of the loss along the curve: the new threshold is always half the window at that moment. Switch to Reno, and to three duplicate ACKs, to see the gentler reaction of the wider topic.
caption.zh: 题目里这条连接，一个往返一个往返地画出来。沿曲线拖动丢包的时刻：新阈值总是那一刻窗口的一半。切换到 Reno，再切换到“三个重复确认”，就能看到后面“全貌”里讲的那种温和反应。

prompt.en: The threshold was 10 KB and the window 16 KB when the timeout happened. What is the new threshold?
prompt.zh: 超时发生时，阈值是 10 KB，窗口是 16 KB。新阈值是多少？

feedback.en: That halves the old threshold. Tahoe halves the window at the moment of the loss.
feedback.zh: 这是把旧阈值减半了。Tahoe 减半的是丢包那一刻的窗口。

feedback.en: The threshold is replaced at every loss; the old 10 KB plays no part.
feedback.zh: 每次丢包都会换掉阈值；旧的 10 KB 不起任何作用。

explain.en: $16 / 2 = 8$: the window at the moment of the loss, halved.

say.en: On a timeout, Tahoe sets the new threshold, written $S'$, to half the window at that moment.
say.zh: 超时时，Tahoe 把新阈值（记作 $S'$）设为那一刻窗口的一半。

say.en: The window was 16 KB. The old threshold, 10 KB, plays no part.
say.zh: 窗口是 16 KB。旧阈值 10 KB 不参与计算。

say.en: The window is reset to 1 segment (1 KB), and slow start begins again.
say.zh: 窗口重置为 1 个报文段（1 KB），重新开始慢启动。

say.en: After the 1st round trip: the one segment is acknowledged, so the window doubles. $2 < 8$: still slow start.
say.zh: 第 1 个往返后：那 1 个报文段被确认，窗口翻倍。$2 < 8$：还在慢启动。
第 2 个往返后：再翻倍。

say.en: After the 3rd: it doubles to 8, which reaches the threshold. From here on, additive increase.
say.zh: 第 3 个往返后：翻倍到 8，正好到达阈值。从这里起改为加法增大。

say.en: After the 4th. The window has reached the threshold, so the rule has changed.
say.zh: 第 4 个往返后。窗口已经到了阈值，规则变了。

outro.en: From the threshold on, additive increase adds one segment per round trip instead of doubling. **Answer:** the threshold becomes 8 KB, and over the next four round trips the window is 2, 4, 8 and 9 KB.
outro.zh: 到了阈值，加法增大每个往返只加一个报文段，不再翻倍。**答案：**阈值变为 8 KB；接下来四个往返，窗口依次是 2、4、8、9 KB。

prompt.en: After the 4th round trip: the window has reached the threshold of 8. What is it now?
prompt.zh: 第 4 个往返后：窗口已经到了阈值 8。现在是多少？

text.en: The chain: the rule on a timeout (half the window, back to 1); the number (8 KB, not from the old threshold); slow start doubling up to the threshold; additive increase after it.
text.zh: 答案链：超时时的规则（窗口减半、回到 1）；算出的数（8 KB，与旧阈值无关）；慢启动翻倍到阈值；之后加法增大。

title.zh: 复习课 (2) 第 3 题 · 满分答案

paras.en: On a timeout, TCP Tahoe sets the slow start threshold to half of the current congestion window: 16 KB / 2 = 8 KB (the old threshold of 10 KB is not used).
paras.zh: 超时时，TCP Tahoe 把慢启动阈值设为当前拥塞窗口的一半：16 KB / 2 = 8 KB（旧阈值 10 KB 不用）。

paras.en: After the window is reset to 1, slow start doubles it every round trip until it reaches the threshold, and then additive increase adds one segment per round trip: 1 RTT after the reset, cwnd = 2 KB; 2 RTT, cwnd = 4 KB; 3 RTT, cwnd = 8 KB (the threshold is reached, so TCP switches to additive increase); 4 RTT, cwnd = 9 KB.
paras.zh: 窗口重置为 1 后，慢启动每个往返让它翻倍，直到到达阈值，之后加法增大每个往返加一个报文段：重置后 1 个 RTT，cwnd = 2 KB；2 个 RTT，cwnd = 4 KB；3 个 RTT，cwnd = 8 KB（到达阈值，TCP 改为加法增大）；4 个 RTT，cwnd = 9 KB。

alt.en: The congestion window against round trips: slow start from 1 to 8, capped at the old threshold 10, additive increase to 16, a timeout at 16, then 1, 2, 4, 8 and 9 under the new threshold 8.
alt.zh: 拥塞窗口随往返的变化：慢启动从 1 到 8，在旧阈值 10 处封顶，加法增大到 16，在 16 处超时，然后在新阈值 8 下依次是 1、2、4、8、9。

caption.en: The question's connection: the timeout at 16, the new threshold at 8, and the four round trips after the reset.
caption.zh: 题目里的连接：16 处超时，新阈值 8，以及重置后的四个往返。

text.en: The classic slip is 16 after the fourth round trip: doubling past the threshold. Write the switch to additive increase in words, as the lecturer's answer does; it shows you know why the fourth step is +1.
text.zh: 最常见的错是第四个往返写成 16：过了阈值还在翻倍。像老师的答案那样，用文字写出“改为加法增大”；这说明你知道第四步为什么只是 +1。

title.en: TCP Reno: not every loss sends you back to 1
title.zh: TCP Reno：不是每次丢包都退回 1

text.en: A timeout means nothing has come back for a long time: the network may be badly congested. But a loss is often noticed earlier and more gently. When one segment is lost and the ones after it still arrive, the receiver keeps acknowledging the last byte it has in order, so the sender sees **duplicate acknowledgements**. Three duplicate ACKs mean one segment is missing while the data behind it is still flowing.
text.zh: 超时意味着很久都没有任何东西回来：网络可能堵得很厉害。但丢包常常能更早、更温和地被发现。一个报文段丢了，后面的却照样到达，接收方会一直确认它按序收到的最后一个字节，于是发送方看到**重复确认**（duplicate ACK）。三个重复确认说明缺了一个报文段，而它后面的数据还在流动。

text.en: **Fast retransmit**: resend the missing segment at once, without waiting for the timeout. (Tahoe does this too, but then still drops the window to 1.)
text.zh: **快速重传**（fast retransmit）：不等超时，马上重发缺的那个报文段。（Tahoe 也这么做，但之后仍把窗口降到 1。）

text.en: **TCP Reno** adds **fast recovery**: after three duplicate ACKs it sets the threshold to half the window as usual, but then continues *from the new threshold* with additive increase, skipping slow start. Only a timeout, or the start of a connection, sends Reno back to a window of 1. Its window then traces a sawtooth: up by one each round trip, halved at each loss.
text.zh: **TCP Reno** 加上了**快速恢复**（fast recovery）：三个重复确认之后，照常把阈值设为窗口的一半，但接着*从新阈值*开始加法增大，跳过慢启动。只有超时（以及连接刚开始时）才会让 Reno 的窗口回到 1。于是它的窗口画出一条锯齿：每个往返加一，每次丢包减半。

rows.zh: $S = W/2$，$W = S$，之后每个 RTT 加 1

text.en: With the question's numbers, under Reno and three duplicate ACKs instead of a timeout: the threshold is 8 KB and the window goes straight to 8 KB, then 9, 10, 11 and 12 over the next four round trips.
text.zh: 用题目的数，如果是 Reno、信号是三个重复确认而不是超时：阈值 8 KB，窗口直接变成 8 KB，接下来四个往返是 9、10、11、12。

text.en: Why halve, and add one? Additive increase with multiplicative decrease is the rule under which connections that share a bottleneck drift towards equal shares: each loss cuts the bigger window by more, while both grow at the same pace.
text.zh: 为什么是减半、加一？在加法增大、乘法减小这条规则下，共用同一个瓶颈的几条连接会逐渐趋向平分带宽：每次丢包，大窗口被砍掉的更多，而两边增长的速度一样。

prompt.en: TCP Tahoe, segments of 1 KB. The slow start threshold is 20 KB, and a timeout occurs when the congestion window is 32 KB. What is the new threshold, in KB?
prompt.zh: TCP Tahoe，每个报文段 1 KB。慢启动阈值是 20 KB，拥塞窗口为 32 KB 时发生超时。新阈值是多少 KB？

explain.en: Half the window at the timeout: $32 / 2 = 16$ KB. The old 20 KB plays no part.
explain.zh: 超时时窗口的一半：$32 / 2 = 16$ KB。旧的 20 KB 不参与。

hints.en: Which number does Tahoe halve: the old threshold, or the window at the timeout?
hints.zh: Tahoe 减半的是哪个数：旧阈值，还是超时时的窗口？

title.en: Your turn: five round trips later

prompt.en: The same connection: after the timeout the window is reset to 1 and no further loss occurs. What is the window after the 5th round trip, in KB?
prompt.zh: 同一条连接：超时后窗口重置为 1，之后不再丢包。第 5 个往返后窗口是多少 KB？

explain.en: Slow start: 2, 4, 8, 16 after four round trips, reaching the threshold of 16; then additive increase: 17 after the fifth.
explain.zh: 慢启动：四个往返后依次是 2、4、8、16，到达阈值 16；然后加法增大：第五个往返后是 17。

hints.en: Double until the window reaches 16, then add one per round trip.
hints.zh: 翻倍到 16，之后每个往返加一。

title.en: Your turn: Reno and duplicate ACKs

prompt.en: Now TCP Reno, threshold 20 KB, window 32 KB, and the loss is signalled by three duplicate ACKs instead of a timeout. What is the congestion window right after, in KB?
prompt.zh: 现在是 TCP Reno，阈值 20 KB，窗口 32 KB，丢包的信号是三个重复确认而不是超时。紧接着拥塞窗口是多少 KB？

explain.en: Fast recovery: the threshold becomes $32/2 = 16$ and the window starts from the threshold, 16 KB, then grows by 1 KB per round trip.
explain.zh: 快速恢复：阈值变为 $32/2 = 16$，窗口从阈值 16 KB 开始，之后每个往返加 1 KB。

prompt.en: Why does Reno treat three duplicate ACKs more gently than a timeout?
prompt.zh: 为什么 Reno 对三个重复确认的反应比对超时更温和？

label.en: Duplicate ACKs show later segments still arriving: data is flowing and only one segment is missing
label.zh: 重复确认说明后面的报文段还在到达：数据在流动，只缺了一个

label.en: Duplicate ACKs mean the receiver's buffer is full
label.zh: 重复确认说明接收方的缓冲区满了

feedback.en: A full buffer is flow control, signalled by the receiver's window. Duplicate ACKs come from a gap in the data.
feedback.zh: 缓冲区满属于流量控制，由接收方的窗口告知。重复确认来自数据里的一个缺口。

label.en: A timeout is usually a false alarm

feedback.en: A timeout means nothing came back for a long time: the strongest sign of congestion TCP has.
feedback.zh: 超时意味着很久什么都没回来：这是 TCP 能得到的最强的拥塞信号。

explain.en: Each duplicate ACK is triggered by a segment that did arrive, so the path still carries data: halving the window is enough. A timeout gives no such evidence, so both Tahoe and Reno start again from 1.
explain.zh: 每个重复确认都是由一个确实到达了的报文段触发的，说明路径还在运送数据：窗口减半就够了。超时没有这样的证据，所以 Tahoe 和 Reno 都从 1 重新开始。
